items.label: PAC-LAND   (PIC)
items.why: Independently runnable bitmap viewer at directory entry 1. After unpacking, it displays a map of Pac-Land with the fairy and Pac.

items.label: PAC-LAND   (MCG)
items.why: The packed boot and MCG intro hand over to the installed game at $033C. The listing is built from that snapshot.

items.label: ^PAC LAND NOTE!^
items.why: Independently runnable RADWAR note. Its screen describes the credit requirement and controls. It has a separate BASIC SYS 2080 entry loaded from directory entry 3.

items.label: PAC-LAND TUNES!!
items.why: Stand-alone music rip identified on the disk and by the CSDb catalog. Eleven aligned chunks match resident music at displacement $ACDC, in both game snapshots.
